description: Report a host's internet-facing exposure from Shodan's InternetDB (keyless): open ports, detected products (CPEs), known CVEs, hostnames and tags. Passive — reads Shodan's own scan data, never touches the target. For a domain the first resolved IP is used (behind a CDN this reflects the edge, not the origin). Read-only.

target.description: IP address or host name, e.g. 1.1.1.1 or example.com

name: host_exposure
